text: Shirui Kashong Peak and Lily is a celebrated destination in Ukhrul, Manipur, renowned for its nature, viewpoints, flowers. Located in the historic and scenic region of Manipur, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Manipur. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
